title: questlog pins.json
description: Compaction pins. Markers on the road where a thread was compacted. Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.4.

kind.description: "compaction" = a manual/synthesized compaction pin; "save_point" = an automatic marker dropped by the PreCompact hook just before compaction (synthesis usually still pending).

afterMilestoneId.description: Road position: marker sits on the segment after this main-quest milestone; null = start of road.

sessionId.description: OPTIONAL. The AI session that dropped this pin (typical on hook-created save_points). Absent/null on hand-made pins.

synthesisPending.description: OPTIONAL. true = a synthesis doc is still owed for this pin (set by the PreCompact save_point hook). Absent/false = nothing pending.
